    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Browsing
    Runs code that drives a browser against a Server of the harness, in the trace of the server: the code runs in a span, each step is a child span, and every request the browser sends to the server carries the current span, so the server's spans are children of the step that caused them.
    Browsing.BrowserBody<T,E>
    Code to run with a browser.
    Options
    How Browsing runs a browser and takes screenshots.
    Options.StepScreenshots
    Screenshots a step takes by itself.
    Session
    A browser session of a Browsing body: the Playwright objects, steps, and screenshots.
    Session.StepBody<E>
    The body of a step.
